title: Central Anatolian languages and language communities in the Colony period: A Luwian-Hattian symbiosis and the independent Hittites
abstract: This paper is the result of the seemingly innocent question “Would you like to say something on the languages and peoples of Anatolia during the Old Assyrian Period”.
